articles.title: BNY and Microsoft complete first AI agent-negotiated Treasury trade
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of New York (BNY) and Microsoft Corp (MSFT) had AI agents negotiate a US Treasury trade. They bill it as the first of its kind.
